backend/main.mo: Motoko canister storing inquiries with input validation and methods to submit and retrieve all inquiries.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing implemented features, related files, components, tests, and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Text file containing short summaries of major frontend components, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/docs/static-assets-checklist.md: Documentation listing all required static image assets, their paths, and verification steps.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS base and theme variables defining the app’s color system and global styles.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point loading fonts and mounting the React application root.
frontend/scripts/list-required-static-as: Node script that extracts required asset paths and optionally verifies their existence in /public.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router with root layout and routes for all main site pages.
frontend/src/components/CategoryHierarch: Component rendering clickable animated subcategory cards with navigation to subcategory routes.
frontend/src/components/ProductQuickView: Modal component displaying product details with image, description, features, and inquiry button, including scroll lock and escape-to-close behavior.
frontend/src/components/SiteFooter.tsx: Footer showing company info, quick links, contact details, and attribution with dynamic year and hostname-based tracking link.
frontend/src/components/SiteHeader.tsx: Responsive header with logo, desktop and mobile navigation, active link highlighting, and scroll-based styling changes.
frontend/src/components/SiteLayout.tsx: Layout wrapper rendering header, footer, and routed page content via Outlet.
Card component for subcategories generating descriptions and placeholder images with reveal animation support.
frontend/src/data/productTaxonomy.ts: Defines structured product category taxonomy including categories, subcategories, and product type lists with images.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook creating and managing authenticated or anonymous backend actors with identity-aware caching and query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for managing Internet Identity authentication using AuthClient, including login, logout, and status state.
frontend/src/hooks/useParallax.ts: Hook that applies a vertical parallax scroll effect to a referenced element unless reduced-motion is preferred.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for submitting inquiries and fetching all inquiries through an actor backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useReducedMotion.ts: Tracks the user's prefers-reduced-motion setting via a media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useRevealOnce.ts: Uses IntersectionObserver to reveal an element once when it enters the viewport.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind-based global stylesheet defining color variables, themes, and component-specific styling for pages and UI elements.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry that initializes React, sets up QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider, and renders App.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders the About page with sections describing the company's mission, values, and highlights.
frontend/src/pages/CataloguePage.tsx: Implements a catalogue request form with validation, submission via inquiry API, and a success screen.
frontend/src/pages/CategoryPage.tsx: Displays a product category page with banner, customization note, subcategories, and navigation actions.
frontend/src/pages/ContactPage.tsx: Implements a contact form with validation, prefilled category support, and inquiry submission via a mutation. Displays a thank‑you screen after successful submission.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the home page with hero, intro, highlights, and CTA sections using parallax and reveal animations. Provides navigation to products and catalogue pages.
frontend/src/pages/ProductsPage.tsx: Displays all product categories with images and navigation to each category’s page. Uses product taxonomy data to generate the grid.
frontend/src/pages/SubcategoryPage.tsx: Shows products for a selected subcategory with banner, navigation, inquiry action, and product quick view modal. Handles missing categories and subcategories.
Defines a centralized list of static assets with descriptions and usage metadata. Helps keep required images synchronized across the app.
frontend/src/utils/slug.ts: Provides helper functions to convert text to URL‑safe slugs and back. Used for consistent slug handling in routes.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind theme, colors, fonts, animations, and plugins for the project. Extends defaults with custom UI tokens and styling behaviors.
project_state.json: Defines project state, issues, and required static images for ensuring local exports match the live site.
